title: New Phyrexia/Intro packs
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Scars of Mirrodin block intro packs)

paragraphs.text: New Phyrexia features five bicolored intro packs designed to showcase the plane's distinct mechanics and strategies, including creature token generation, flying and equipment synergies, aggressive creature removal, and life manipulation through Phyrexian mana. Each deck focuses on a specific color pair and theme, such as Golems and Splicers in Artful Destruction (green/white), flying and Equipment in Devouring Skies (blue/black), creature destruction in Feast of Flesh (black/red), life gain and Phyrexian mana in Life for Death (red/white), and a final deck emphasizing infect and poison counters. These intro packs provide a mix of powerful creatures, spells, and artifacts to help new players learn the mechanics of New Phyrexia while offering customization options for more advanced deck building.

Artful Destruction is a green / white intro pack with a focus on Golems and "Splicers", which create Golem creature tokens when they enter the battlefield and confer a benefit to Golems as long as they are on the battlefield.
The rares in this deck are Blade Splicer (holographic foil) and Precursor Golem .
Devouring Skies is a blue / black intro pack with a focus on creatures with flying and equipment.
The rares in this deck are Phyrexian Ingester (holographic foil) and Argentum Armor .
Feast of Flesh is an aggro/control black / red intro pack with a focus on creature removal.
The rares in this deck are Chancellor of the Dross (holographic foil) and Tower of Calamities .
Feast of Flesh is a red / white intro pack with a focus on life gain and Phyrexian mana .
The rares in this deck are Moltensteel Dragon (holographic foil) and Phyrexian Rebirth .
Ravaging Swarm is a green / blue intro pack with a focus on infect .
The rares in this deck are Phyrexian Swarmlord , Inexorable Tide .
